mensūrālis , e, adj. id.,
I.of or belonging to measuring, measuring- (post-class.): mensuralis linea, Sicul. Fl. p. 19 Goes.— Plur. as subst.: mensūrālia , ium, n., the title of a work by Varro, Prisc. p. 817 P.— Hence, adv.: mensūrālĭter , by measure (post-class.), Hyg. de Limit. p. 167 Goes.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
